dedupe_keys.name: pact performance assessment calculation tool fema p 58

description: PACT, the Performance Assessment Calculation Tool, is the computational companion to FEMA P-58 Volume 1 and is distributed in Volume 3 as a Windows executable, currently version 3.1.2, downloadable as a zip file. It is both a calculator and a repository of fragility and consequence data: it runs the probabilistic calculations and loss accumulation of the methodology, with utilities to specify building properties and to update or modify fragility and consequence information. It supports scenario-based, intensity-based and time-based assessments and accepts results from nonlinear response history analyses or simplified analyses. Its three functions gather building information, fragility functions and demand parameters; compute repair cost, downtime and casualty estimates; and report losses overall and by performance group. Coverage: individual buildings, with default data reflecting U.S. practice. Access: free download; Appendix C of Volume 2 is the user manual. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: it installs from a Windows .exe file, and the analyst must supply structural response results. Simulation uses: building-specific seismic loss, downtime and casualty estimates for design and retrofit decisions and for resilience studies. Related records: the FEMA P-58 fragility and consequence database and the open-source pelicun, which implements the same method.
